name: Cúllar Vega (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cúllar Vega (ears of wheat, waves and a flower).
history: Cúllar Vega adopted its arms and flag officially on 14 September 2009; the flag is a cloth of 3:2 divided horizontally into three stripes of equal width, green, white and blue from top to bottom.

features.role: Cúllar Vega arms — ears of wheat, waves and flower
